messages.author: Ngozi Okafor
messages.text: Grace already holds payments-initiate — approver access is a straight segregation-of-duties conflict, refuse it and cite the clause. Tomas's SEC-ATT lapsed in March; he re-attests first.

messages.author: Elin Bergström
messages.text: Marcus's second request is a duplicate of the first — count it once. Grants are 30 days for restricted; the expedite fee and any tier-2 exception are Declan's call, not ours.

messages.author: Grace Odum
messages.text: Understood on the conflict. Leave me a note with what cleared and what did not.
